description:
Cast Deep Forest Hermit by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Deep Forest Hermit enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating eight 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing seven Squirrels, adding {4}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deep Forest Hermit to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
